snippet.title: Educational PC game "The Bright Path" - trailer and introduction video
snippet.description:
"The Bright Path" is an interactive educational computer game focused on education of young people and the players in the topics of drug abuse, drug addiction and active citizenship. You can download the game and try it  for free in the link below. The game is funded by the Erasmus+ programme of the European Union.

You can check and try out the game on Steam at this link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554930/The_Bright_Path/
